title: Practice 2: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Как далеко ты можешь ___ (заплыть / заплывать)?
exercises.why: **заплы́ть** — **заплыва́ть** — to swim (somewhere far away); to swim or sail .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with в (v, + accusative) ‘into somewhere’]. **занести́** — **заноси́ть** — to bring, to carry (in); to note down, to enter (data, records). **завести́** — **заводи́ть** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: How far can you swim?
exercises.context: заплы́ть** — **заплыва́ть — to swim (somewhere far away); to swim or sail .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with в (v, + accusative) ‘into somewhere’].

exercises.q: В закрытый рот муха не ___ (залететь / залетать).
exercises.why: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: A fly does not fly into a shut mouth.
exercises.context: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..

exercises.q: Круизный лайнер ___ (зайти / заходить) в Гонконг.
exercises.why: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The liner called at Hong Kong.
exercises.context: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака.

exercises.q: Во сколько Том за тобой ___ (заезжать / заехать)?
exercises.why: Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: What time's Tom picking you up?
exercises.context: Автомашина заезжает за дом.

exercises.q: ___ (забежать / забегать) ко мне на обратном пути.
exercises.why: **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. **зае́хать** — **заезжа́ть** — to call in on the way; to drive into. **залете́ть** — **залета́ть** — to fly (in, into); to fly (as high as), to go up (as far as), to fly (as far as), to fly (behind, beyond). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Swing by my place on the way back.
exercises.context: за- (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat..
